predecessors.name: Gupta Empire
predecessors.text: the Gangetic heartland that Cliopatria hands to the Maukharis in 555 (the Gupta page lists them among its successors)

successors.name: Harsha's Empire (Pushyabhuti dynasty)
successors.text: Kannauj and the Gangetic plain, 'eventually absorbed into the territory of Harsha'

ledger.x: 554: Isanavarman raises the Maukharis to independence at Kannauj.

c. 605: Grahavarman is killed and Kannauj falls. Grahavarman (r. c. 600-605) was 'killed in battle by Devagupta of Malwa'; the page gives no year beyond the reign. Shashanka's Gauda is not named on the page; the Shashanka page has Harsha's brother Rajyavardhana killed by Shashanka c. 606.
606: the Maukhari line ends and Harsha takes its land.

wars.name: Isanavarman's wars against the Huns, Gaudas, Andhras and Sulikas
wars.outcome: Isanavarman 'defeated them in battle' (the Alchon Huns); the Haraha inscription of 554 records 'further military victories against the Gaudas, Andhras and Sulikas'.

wars.name: Maukhari-Later Gupta rivalry over Magadha
wars.outcome: The Maukharis 'had a rivalry with the Later Guptas of Magadha'; the Aphsad inscription credits a Later Gupta king with defeating Maukhari elephant forces.

wars.name: Fall of Kannauj
wars.outcome: Grahavarman was killed by Devagupta of Malwa c.

certainty.note: No frontier is described beyond 'Thaneshwar in the West to Nalanda district in the east'; Cliopatria's outline follows the Gupta heartland.
